! Title: Google Search Slop Blocker (Lite)
! Description: Blocks "AI Overview" feature from Google Search.
! Homepage: https://github.com/SalaryTheft/gssb
! License: MIT
! Expires: 1 day
! Last modified: 2026-10-01

! AI Overview XHR
://www.google.com/async/folsrch?*$xhr
! AI Overview
google.com/search##div[data-cb-scope]
google.com/search##div[data-aquarium]
google.com##:matches-path(/^\/search(?:\?|$)/) div[data-cb-scope]
google.com##:matches-path(/^\/search(?:\?|$)/) div[data-aquarium]
